why_ai: AI-generated abuse grows demand, but foundation-model moderation APIs compete directly with vendor classifiers.
why_clarity: Massive classification volume, but accuracy is self-reported with no shared benchmark.
why_digital: Content in, classifications and enforcement actions out via API.

why_ai: Routing, deduplication and appeals handling are mechanical workflow software performs.
why_clarity: Queue, routing and audit-trail rules are explicit and recur on every report.
why_digital: Reports in, routed cases and decision records out.

why_ai: Classifiers are the automation; frontier multimodal models now substitute vendor models directly.
why_clarity: Huge volume, but context-dependent harms and undisclosed test sets leave accuracy unverified.
why_digital: Text, image, video and audio in, labels out at platform scale.

why_ai: Setting the exchange rate between over-removal and under-removal is a values judgment accountable to regulators.
why_clarity: No correct answer exists; it is a stated values position never objectively checked.
why_digital: Deliberation with policy leaders, regulators and civil society produces a written position.

why_ai: New adversarial abuse patterns arrive before labels exist, requiring judgment as well as anomaly signals.
why_clarity: Each novel harm is one-off, detected by whoever notices, with damage known weeks later.
why_digital: Platform signals and reports in, detections and model updates out.

why_ai: The threshold encodes regulated trade-offs between incomparable harms, which policy leaders must own.
why_clarity: Thresholds recur per harm type, but whether the balance is right stays contested.
why_digital: Score distributions on screen, chosen with policy teams and regulators.

why_ai: A neutral, trusted evaluator is the product, and regulatory accuracy reporting increases demand.
why_clarity: Benchmark design is technically standard, but coordinating shared test sets is not routine.
why_digital: Test sets and model outputs evaluated digitally, sold to buyers and regulators.

why_ai: Translating prose policy into classifier configuration and verifying it is what LLMs do well.
why_clarity: Policy-to-configuration mapping is checkable, though exceptions need interpretation.
why_digital: Written policy in, configuration out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Commodity subcontracted labelling, though context-dependent harmful content still needs human ground truth.
why_clarity: Policy-defined labels on queues of similar items, with annotator disagreement on ambiguous cases.
why_digital: Content in a labelling tool, labels out, offshore by design.

why_ai: One person carries child-safety reporting duties, law enforcement requests and novel abuse judgment calls.
why_clarity: Many separate specialisms, each handled differently, with slow and partial outcome signals.
why_digital: Vendor dashboards, backlogs and reports, all on screen.

why_ai: Given stated costs and score distributions, the optimal threshold is a computation software maintains.
why_clarity: A known optimisation with a computable answer, testable against outcomes.
